cleave.role: Full-body frontal melee ability; approved local reference
cleave.controls: Palette, width, erosion, emission, decorative fragments, sound. ability is authoritative gameplay data; do not change it in an art trial.
cleave.coverage_limits: No moving caster, interrupted-cast movie, isolated single-hit, wall/slope-specific or hardware matrix. Integration tests cover some cancellation and geometry behavior separately.

sword.role: Ordinary physical attack, actual blade-anchor history
sword.controls: Emission, arc/contact opacity, shards, trail thickness and tail. Preserve source anchors and combat timing.
sword.coverage_limits: Coverage contains close/day/night/crowd/miss. Frozen targets do not demonstrate physical knockback; rapid changes capture cadence only.

mine.role: Radial explosion from real mine detonation, with terrain-sampled ground presentation
mine.controls: Fire/smoke size, lifetime, opacity, emission, embers and light. Harness passes real blast radius to VFX.
mine.coverage_limits: Coverage contains boundaries and voxel steps. Frozen actors do not show knockback. No basic-attack comparison, isolated miss or real-time renderer stress.

archer.role: Actual projectile surface contact and directional impact
archer.controls: Contact painting, dust, chips, glow. Keep actual projectile collision authoritative.
archer.coverage_limits: Coverage contains close/day/night/crowd/direction changes; surface includes real wall and empty-space miss. No special/basic comparison or real-time stress.

stamps.role: Subordinate sprite accents; component preview, not an ability
stamps.controls: Texture, tint, size, lifetime, rise, drift and local emission. No damage, light or camera shake.
stamps.coverage_limits: Isolated camera and background. It cannot establish production integration, terrain, target contact or ability readability.
